subject: Milwaukee M18 XC5.0 2-pack $129 (retailer compare-at $269)
summary: A Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 two-pack at $129 at ToolNut, against the retailer's own $269 compare-at price.
body: Black Friday pick: the Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 extended capacity battery 2-pack (48-11-1852) is $129 at ToolNut, in stock when we checked this morning. That's about $64.50 a pack.
ToolNut lists a compare-at price of $269, about 52% off. Compare-at is the retailer's own number, not a street price, so treat the discount as a ceiling.
Tip: if your bench runs M18 tools, a spare pair of 5.0Ah packs saves you a mid-job charge wait. Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
